add.name: Crystal Creek basin below the Southwest Rib
add.capacity: A few informal sites on the basin floor
add.permit: Outside the Enchantment Permit Area once far enough down the basin; self-issue Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit
add.notes: Informal camping on the floor of Crystal Creek basin near the toe of the rib. Reach it by hiking up Crystal Creek from the Ingalls Creek trail, or by dropping south from Crystal Lake on the Enchantment plateau along its outlet stream.

overnightPermit.what: Free self-issue Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit in lower Crystal Creek; an Enchantment zone permit to camp at Crystal Lake itself
overnightPermit.where: Fill one out at the Ingalls Creek trailhead kiosk. Camping at Crystal Lake on the plateau needs an Enchantment Permit Area permit from Recreation.gov, May 15 to Oct 31.

routes.note: Every listed camp serves the Colchuck/Aasgard side; the route base is in Crystal Creek, reached from Ingalls Creek or down from Crystal Lake.
